mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_follow_artist (user_id, artist_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{artistId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follow_artist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND artist_id = #{artistId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow_artist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND artist_id = #{artistId}

SELECT a.id, a.name, a.stage_name, a.avatar_url, a.gender, a.nationality, a.tags, a.bio, a.description, a.social_links, a.follow_count, a.show_count, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM user_follow_artist ufa JOIN artist a ON a.id = ufa.artist_id WHERE ufa.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 1 ORDER BY ufa.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}
